5. [ASSISTANT_SAID] A home inspection is a thorough examination of a property's condition by a licensed professional, evaluating major systems including roof and exterior, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, interior, insulation and ventilation, and foundation and structure.
6. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The inspector will provide a detailed report outlining the property's condition, including defects, deficiencies, or safety concerns.
7. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Minor issues are common and can include leaky faucets, cracked tiles, or worn-out seals.
8. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Major issues can include structural damage, foundation issues, or environmental hazards like mold or asbestos, which may require renegotiation or walking away from the deal.
9. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can negotiate with the seller to repair or credit for issues found in the inspection report.
10. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for navigating the home inspection process include hiring a reputable inspector, attending the inspection, reviewing the report carefully, prioritizing issues, and keeping emotions in check.
11. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Common mistakes homebuyers make during the home inspection process include not hiring a reputable inspector, not attending the inspection, not understanding the report, overreacting to minor issues, not negotiating effectively, and not budgeting for repairs.
12. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The inspection report should include a summary, introduction, details on the exterior, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, interior, insulation and ventilation, appliances, environmental concerns, and recommendations.
13. [ASSISTANT_SAID] To evaluate the inspector's work, the user should check the report's length and detail, look for specific examples, check for photos, evaluate the inspector's credentials, and ask questions.
14. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The typical cost of a home inspection ranges from $300 to $1,000, with an average around $500 to $600.
